result.reason: The clause largely implements the preferred cap, mutuality, listed uncapped carve-outs, and payment-obligation treatment. However, it measures fees during the 12 months preceding the event giving rise to the claim rather than the claim, which can materially change the cap and was unnecessary. It also retains a duplicated, malformed paragraph beginning “10 LIABILITY RELATES” and uses Section 8—not the defined Excluded Claims—as the exception to the consequential-damages exclusion, creating inconsistent treatment of the carve-outs. These defects prevent the operative language from cleanly reaching the playbook position and materially undermine drafting quality.
